message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to buy or auction the property at PENNSYLVANIA_AVENUE.

I own two of the three pink properties. I have $846 cash and no greens yet. Player two has $595 and owns several utilities plus Pennsylvania RR.

Player three owns Oriental, Tennessee, and Illinois. Player four owns Mediterranean, New York, and North Carolina. If I buy Pennsylvania Avenue, I will own one green property and player four will own the other.

I can afford to buy Pennsylvania Avenue. I would retain $526 cash, which covers Virginia and house money. Purchasing it now prevents player four from acquiring the property cheaply through an auction and building toward a green monopoly.

Player four has the strongest incentive to acquire Pennsylvania Avenue. Completing the green group would require Pacific Avenue and trading with player four, so that path is impractical. The pink monopoly remains the better long-term target. House costs on greens are $200 each, making pink houses a far better return on investment. Strategy guidance favors buying properties early to deny opponents.

Auctioning would let player four acquire the property for a low price. I would need to conserve cash for Virginia and house money, but that leaves only about sixty-six dollars remaining.

I will buy Pennsylvania Avenue. Player four already owns North Carolina, so completing the green group would be a serious threat. I can trade the property later or block their set. Pacific Avenue remains unowned.
